hooks.name: Typecheck gate
hooks.description: Blocks a Kiro agent from stopping while the skeleton typecheck is red; the errors come back as the agent's next message.

hooks.name: Unit tests for the saved engine file
hooks.description: After a skeleton source file is saved, runs the Vitest files related to it.

hooks.name: Compile robot requirements
hooks.description: When a robot's requirements file is saved, golem check compiles every EARS line (GOLEM dogfooding itself).

action.command: node skeleton/dist/cli/main.js check --app apps/stagger && node skeleton/dist/cli/main.js check --app apps/candy
